title: Finite intrinsic projection compatibility
statement: Fix D,C,E,m,S as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. For the specified constructed tensor family canonicalFiniteIntrinsicTensorComparison [def-sf-canonical-finite-intrinsic-tensor-comparison], the displayed finite projection compatibility equation holds for every compactified morphism f:X→Y, bounded constructible K, finite-Tor bounded constructible L, and ambient inputs U,V with k:U≅K.obj and l:V≅L.obj [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. The tensor family is fixed by its construction, not universally quantified.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Use the proper counit comparison and the complementary open/compositor comparison at the same explicitly constructed midpoint. Replace the intrinsic tail using the second equation, reassociate, and apply the first equation. Unfold the fixed constructible conjugation using component_factorization; the result is the stated full equation.

proof_origin.place: Pasting the separately normalized proper and open/compositor factor equations.

from.place: Strictly smaller component of parent proof

lean.statement:
theorem finiteIntrinsicProjectionCompatibility
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m)) :
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X)
        (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E (m + 1)
          (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) Y.obj.left)
        (U : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E X.obj.left m)
        (V : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E Y.obj.left m)
        (k : U ≅ K.obj) (l : V ≅ L.obj),
        SystemProjectionFormula.finiteProjection C.l E D C.different c
            X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom m U V ≫
          (sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map
            ((canonicalFiniteIntrinsicTensorComparison (C := C) (E := E) m X).hom.app
              (U, (finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).obj V) ≫
              (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
                (Prod.mkHom k.hom
                  ((finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).map l.hom ≫
                    (S.finitePullback f).inv.app ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩))) ≫
          (S.finiteSupport f c).inv.app
            (((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S X).obj K).obj
              ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S f).obj L)) =
        (canonicalFiniteIntrinsicTensorComparison (C := C) (E := E) m Y).hom.app
            ((sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1)
              (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).obj U, V) ≫
          (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (Prod.mkHom
              ((sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1)
                (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map k.hom ≫
                (S.finiteSupport f c).inv.app K) l.hom) ≫
          (finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component S f c K L)
